TextBlock.Text: THEATRE South of Gwadar
DATE 6 November 2028 · 0130 local
SIDE Pakistan Navy
WINDOW 75 min, closes at 112
Oliver Hazard Perry class, the class of PNS Alamgir (family reference: US Navy photo, 1977). Photo: Bath Iron Works · Public domain · cropped
"It's not enough to talk about deterrence: I believe we must demonstrate that we can deliver air power to degrade, disrupt, destroy, and defeat."
- Air Marshal Stephen Chappell, Chief of Air Force, RAAF, 2026

SOUTH OF GWADAR, 0130. MV MERIDIAN SENTINEL, the merchant fleet intelligence believes fuels and arms Meridian's trawlers, is steaming east fifty miles south of the coast without lights. Two of the trawlers are waiting for her somewhere ahead.

PNS HANGOR is dived across her track. Classify SENTINEL on passive sonar, then take the boat within three miles of the trail datum marked east of you, on her rendezvous. The trail is complete when SENTINEL has been classified and HANGOR is inside that circle afterwards. If any Meridian ship classifies HANGOR, the trail is blown and the operation has failed. Nothing is fired: the boat starts at weapons Hold, and sinking any ship here ends the operation.
Dhows and a tanker bound for the Gulf are in the sonar picture. Use them.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Commander Pakistan Fleet, Karachi; submarine operating authority
COMMANDER'S INTENT

The trawlers that came for Gwadar were fuelled and armed at sea. Find the ship that does it and know her: her signature is what the next convoy's escort will hunt by. Hangor is a trail, not an attack. She is not seen, and she fires nothing.
• Classify Meridian Sentinel, then take Hangor within three miles of the trail datum
• Keep Hangor off Meridian's plot: no Meridian ship may classify her
• Fire on nothing
• Bring Hangor through intact
• Harm no dhow or tanker
PNS Hangor (S-131), an S-26P, dived. Opposing: MV Meridian Sentinel, an armed merchant, and two armed trawlers at her rendezvous. Neutral: fishing dhows and a tanker.

The planned window is 75 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 37 minutes more; the operation is closed at 112 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
